name: usage-process
title: The whole usage process, designed: one page, every step naming the failure it prevents
description: A routed design page for the whole usage process (install, first project, first real work, refusals, formal-task closure, the second day, maintenance), with each stage stating what the user does, what the product decides for them, the specific failure it prevents, and the current reading or owning task; plus a pointer from the product page record instead of a second telling of it.
